title: Aris Helicopters

services.name: ​ Helicopter Parts
services.desc: IHP Worldwide stocks a large variety of commercial and military aircraft spares. We carry a large inventory of Sikorsky parts for the H-19, S-55, H-34, S-58, S-58T, H-3, S-61, S-62, and CH-54 Sky-crane helicopters. In addition, we carry parts for the Bell OH-58, UH-1, 204, 205, 206, 209, 212 and 412, Eurocopter parts and Hughes OH-6 / 500 parts. Our stock includes inverters, brakes, instruments, gauges, sensors, on-board weighing systems, sheet metal components, bellcranks, hydraulic pumps and motors, Pratt & Whitney, and Wright 1820 (Cyclone 989C9HE-2) engine parts as well as an assortment of hardware, and tooling. We also have numerous avionic subcomponents such as AC and DC motors,

blurb: Since 1972, Aris Helicopters has proudly served the Western United States with aerial solutions that blend precision, efficiency, and unwavering safety. Headquartered in Northern and Southern California, we specialize in aerial construction, heavy lift operations, firefighting, utility and telecom support, charter flights, and cinematic production
